svg.title: Tower Defense · Spark (electricity) tower (#22) · Direction C: Rune Conductor
svg.text: Spark tower · Direction C: Rune Conductor
Tower Defense · art request #22 (3D-looking electricity tower, fantasy, cozy) · concept sheet, not final art
1 · Base tower at real in-game size (1x) and at 3x
Scene: one board cell beside the road (1x)
base · Storm II · Overload II, beside the road
Storm II · branch A, rust mark
Overload II · branch B, gold mark
Storm: chains to 5 (more rods, more arcs)
Overload: full damage every jump (bigger core)
Idea: two leaning stone pillars with teal caps on a timber deck, a floating faceted spark crystal arcing to both; strong faceted planes read as 3D.
Risk: the least cozy (more arcane than homely), and the blue crystal sits close to the Frost tower's crystal, so the two could get confused.
Storm adds a third pillar and a top arc; Overload grows the crystal with gold rings. Glow edge uses Frost #8FC8D8, so check it against the Frost tower.
